verdict: Organic presence is active across all locations; paid campaigns remain paused.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, your Google Business Profile listings generated 391 combined actions — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — with no paid spend running on Meta or Google. O'Hare Precision was the standout, with GBP activity up 22% week over week, while Forte Metals and Advance Grinding both saw a sharp drop in GBP engagement in the final days of the window, each falling to near-zero actions by August 8–10. With paid campaigns fully offline, organic local search is carrying all the weight, and any softness in listing visibility has a direct impact. We're investigating the late-period drop in GBP engagement at Forte and Advance Grinding and will confirm whether this is a visibility issue or a shift in search demand; expect a clearer picture next week.
